shared_shape_observations: Long 20m class straight passenger side, rolled/rounded roof shoulder, ribbed central roof sheet; one low trapezoidal HVAC at each end, large grille integrated in each casing. Rounded lower side/body underside, two 2-axle bogies; central gangway door in rectangular bellows on rounded-top end, low central coupler and hanging hoses. Door plates/glazing follow true shell; do not infer hidden wiring or mirror equipment.
